name: Dumbbell Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted and hold two dumbbells above your chest, palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells lightly together or keep them close with your shoulder blades anchored to the pad.
Bend your elbows close to your ribs to lower both dumbbells toward the center of your chest.
Press straight upward until your elbows extend above your chest.
tips: Keep the dumbbells parallel and your wrists stacked straight over your elbows.
Keep your elbows tucked near your sides rather than letting them flare wide.
